eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Jefferson, WA; at 4:48 PM on AUG 1, 2023 Effective until 4:48 PM AUG 2, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Large brush fire at 6037 Beaver Valley Rd. All residents approx. 1/2 south on east side of road advised to evacuate (approximately Templet Drive to Tall Tree Lane) Residents advised to evacuate immediately if in affected area. Contact Jefferson County DEM at 360-385-9368 with questions. Call 911 for life threatening emergencies.
